apis.name: scene.capabilities
constraints: Call before generating mutations when the runtime build is not known.

apis.name: scene.describe
apis.signature: scene.describe({ scope?, depth?, maxNodes?, include? }) -> SceneDescription
constraints: Returns a bounded semantic projection, never ECS objects.

apis.name: scene.inspect
constraints: Use after flush to verify runtime ownership, hierarchy, and capabilities.

apis.name: scene.findByName
constraints: Name matching is exact and case-sensitive.
Returns semantic Artifact, instance-scoped, or Scene-created nodes only; mounted ECS clone ids are never traversed or returned.
Duplicate names are preserved in deterministic scene-tree order within the semantic domain; no match or an unresolved scope returns an empty array.
global is limited to the owning FlamoInstance and does not cross runtime instances.
Use ctx.mounted.resolve/children/probe when current physical materialization is required.

apis.name: scene.create
constraints: Creates a detached runtime node.
Built-in primitives are framework-owned and do not depend on a Figma template.

apis.name: scene.mount
apis.signature: scene.mount(node, { parent, index? | before? | after?, position? })
constraints: Exactly zero or one placement selector may be supplied.
References must resolve inside the same instance.

apis.name: scene.apply
apis.signature: await scene.apply(mutations, { dryRun?, atomic?, clientMutationId?, source? })
constraints: Prefer this structured path for AI-generated changes.
clientMutationId makes retries idempotent.

apis.name: scene.flush
constraints: Wait before probe, inspect, screenshot, or harness verification.

apis.name: scene.verify
constraints: Checks committed revision, node existence/removal, and hierarchy after flush.
Visual and interaction-specific contracts still require screenshot/trace harness assertions.

apis.name: scene.snapshot
constraints: Snapshot is read-only runtime evidence.

apis.name: scene.exportPatch
constraints: Ephemeral nodes are excluded by default.
Persistence remains explicit.
